notes.title: The Real Laser Ball Patch 2
notes.notes: I received a few reports of some of the hidden achievements being finicky to unlock, or not triggering when supposed to. This patch fixes those items.

notes.title: The Real Laser Ball Patch 1
notes.notes: Patch to correct the issue with the Bomber related achievements not triggering. These should now trigger properly when destroying the correct amount of Bombers.
